name: claude-code-nvim-sidecar
description: Bridges claude-code.nvim to the Claude Agent SDK over newline-delimited JSON on stdio.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node18 --outfile=../dist/sidecar.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
